title: Acronis Backup: attackers can gain admin rights
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 51 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Servers and backups
category.why: It runs or protects many systems at once, including your backups.
category.doThis: Patch it and keep its admin access off the internet.

summary: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 19, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-87886 as actively exploited
